jobs.title: Security Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Security Program Manager

Security Services, Cybersecurity & Compliance

We are Lennar

Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.

A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future

Lennar has an opportunity for a Security Program Manager within the Resilience and Security Services organization, working in close partnership with Security, primarily comprised of Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) and Privacy, to run the enterprise program that keeps Lennar's NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) controls backed by clear, current policy and verifiable evidence of adherence. This role reports directly to the Director, Resilience and Security Services.

The Security Program Manager is Lennar's primary point of contact for internal and external audit engagements and regulatory inquiries, and the trusted advisor to the federation of control owners across Lennar IT (LTG) who author and maintain policy. This is a program management role at its core: the Security Program Manager runs the assurance program end-to-end, setting the annual cadence, managing cross-functional workstreams, and holding every deliverable, policy review, evidence request, and audit response to a disciplined program plan. Additional insight into cybersecurity and IT auditing is a major plus.

A career with purpose.
A career built on making dreams come true.
A career built on building zero defect homes, cost management, and adherence to schedules.

Your Responsibilities On The Team

Lead and manage the enterprise assurance program as a structured, multi-workstream initiative, applying disciplined program and project management practices (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid, as appropriate) to keep every deliverable on time and within scope.
Build and maintain the year-long assurance calendar, aligning evidence-gathering activity, policy reviews, and audit response with Lennar's regulatory and audit calendars.
Own the enterprise policy library: maintain an accurate, current inventory of every policy tied to an enforced NIST CSF control, manage the policy lifecycle on an annual review cadence, and read every policy closely for clarity, completeness, and fidelity to the intent of the underlying control.
Design and maintain the standard process flow that governs how a policy moves from draft through review, giving control owners a clear, repeatable path to a compliant policy. Security retains final review and sign-off authority on every policy; the Security Program Manager ensures the process is followed.
Own the evidence library: ensure evidence is properly cataloged, stored, and retrievable, and that evidence approaching the end of its one-year validity window is refreshed before it expires.
Serve as Lennar's primary liaison to internal and external audit teams and regulatory bodies, leading the response to audit and regulatory evidence requests with a service-oriented, no-surprises approach, and reusing previously validated evidence wherever it falls within its one-year validity period.
Partner directly with control and policy owners across the LTG federation, providing patient, constructive guidance and facilitating solution-oriented working sessions that keep policy work moving ahead of Security's final review.
Lead the evaluation and selection of the system(s) of record for the policy and evidence libraries, anticipated to be a combination of SharePoint and AuditBoard, with final tooling to be determined as an initial program deliverable.
Identify and help assess security and compliance risks surfacing from policy gaps, control weaknesses, or stale evidence, applying working knowledge of relevant frameworks (NIST CSF, SOC, PCI, FFIEC) to escalate substantive issues to Security and the Director, Resilience and Security Services.
Communicate program status, risks, and issues to stakeholders and senior management, including VP/SVP-level leadership, in clear, concise, executive-ready formats.
Mentor and guide program contributors, including a proposed Security Analyst II role should it be approved, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and disciplined execution.
Analyze multi-domain assurance trend data, including audit findings, evidence turnaround, and policy currency, to institutionalize process fixes and improve reliability at scale.
Maintain the assurance program's source of truth in Lennar's management platforms, ensuring all artifacts meet global security and audit control standards.
Define program requirements by managing milestones, forming working teams with control owners, and establishing budgets where applicable; monitor progress by tracking activity, resolving problems, and publishing progress reports.

Requirements

7+ years of professional experience spanning IT project/program management, audit, risk, compliance, or governance, including at least 5 years leading multi-workstream projects or programs.
Proven program/project management discipline: experience with Agile (Scrum, XP), Waterfall/Predictive, and hybrid methodologies; PMP certification preferred.
Extremely detail-oriented and hyper-organized, comfortable owning a portfolio of concurrent, time-sensitive deliverables (policy reviews, evidence requests, audit responses) without dropping a thread.
Experience interacting with internal or external audit teams, with a service-oriented mindset and the presence to represent Lennar credibly in audit and regulatory conversations.
Demonstrated ability to read, interpret, and translate the intent of a policy into practical guidance for control owners; collaborative and personable enough to coach non-compliance professionals through it.
Working knowledge of the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) and NIST SP 800-53 control families, or a comparable enterprise control framework; familiarity with SOC, PCI, and FFIEC compliance requirements is a strong plus.
Additional insight into cybersecurity and IT auditing, including security risk and vulnerability identification, is a major plus.
Experience selecting, implementing, or administering Security and document management platforms; direct experience with AuditBoard and SharePoint preferred.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with an emphasis on facilitating solution-oriented meetings and briefing VP/SVP-level stakeholders on status, risk, and trade-offs.
Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Risk Management, or a related field; Master's degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
Certifications a plus: PMP, CISA, CRISC, CIA, CGEIT, CISSP, or equivalent.

Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements:

Regular, in-person attendance at the Lennar office during regular work hours is an essential function of this job. This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.

This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the position noted. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Associates. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Life at Lennar

At Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits.

Join the fun and follow us on social media to see what's happening at our company, and don't forget to connect with us on Lennar: Overview | LinkedIn<https://www.linkedin.com/company/lennar/> for the latest job opportunities.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Global Business Services’ (GBS) Commercial Solutions team ensures operational and programmatic excellence across deal cycles, increases revenue through the development of transformative commercial constructs, and drives closure of Stripe’s sold portfolio. The team's reach is widespread across Stripe, not exclusive to one sales segment or geographical region. GBS drives change across go-to-market, positively impacting Stripe users, and cross-functional teams. GBS’s priorities are set through the direction of Stripe leadership and executive vision, partnership with sales and cross-functional organizations, as well as User feedback and market insights. This role sits within Global Business Practices’ Commercial Solutions team, responsible for developing, launching, and maintaining commercial constructs and programs to drive revenue for Stripe.

What you’ll do

Stripe's Global Business Services' Commercial Solutions team is looking for a Commercial Solutions Program Manager to own the end-to-end programmatic development of commercial and GBS launch readiness programs that drive revenue for Stripe. Programs have a large scope and impact in nature, including owning the development and support of first-of-its-kind commercialization efforts, ongoing program support (pre- to post-launch), custom deal support related to the program, ownership of related enablement and communications, as well as acting as a change agent across the business.

You're responsible for the end-to-end management of commercial and GBS launch readiness programs, driving cross-organizational alignment through the delivery of related outputs. This role requires a background in program management and commercial program experience, change management, a strong understanding of private pricing frameworks (and pricing analysis), and experience scaling global, cross-organizational mechanisms.

You have experience in program management ownership, custom pricing strategies, and a background in supporting selling motions. You have strong communication skills and executive presence to effectively communicate with Stripe senior leadership. You'll love this role if you're a natural relationship and mechanism builder.

Responsibilities

Independently lead large scale, cross-functional commercial or GBS launch readiness programs that have Stripe-wide impact, oftentimes first-of-its-kind programs and initiatives
Manage and lead a highly complex program which requires considerable resources and high levels of complex functional and technical integration and knowledge
Support the commercial program deal motion, partnering with Deal Pricing and Deal Strategy Strategists, sellers, and internal stakeholders to solution custom commercial approaches
Work cross-functionally with sales teams, sales leaders, services/support teams, product teams, and cross-functional teams to develop, launch, and scale the commercial program (continuously evolving the ways Stripe goes to market) to support commercialization efforts
Identify, surface, and action systemic, broad issues and gaps, proposing holistic solutions to address root causes
Navigate and propose creative solutions through complex programmatic problems at scale across Go-To-Market and Stripe
Partner with cross-functional teams such as Legal, Finance, Accounting, Service Teams, Product Teams, etc. to resolve and remove internal blockers
Provide coaching for other Commercial Solutions team members, identifying areas to upskill across the function
Act as a liaison within Sales, Deal Pricing and Deal Strategy Strategists, and other stakeholders for custom elements
Facilitate meetings, working sessions, and exercises that assist the leadership team in optimizing effectiveness among themselves and across the organization in general
Advocate on behalf of a position and quickly gain cross-functional alignment on the position
Quickly build credibility and trust with internal stakeholders
Provide strong leadership, communication, and persuasion skills
Lead projects to solve existing commercialization issues

Who you are

Independently lead large scale, cross-functional commercial or GBS launch readiness programs that have Stripe-wide impact, oftentimes first-of-its-kind programs and initiatives
Manage and lead a highly complex program which requires considerable resources and high levels of complex functional and technical integration and knowledge

Facilitate meetings, working sessions, and exercises that assist the leadership team in optimizing effectiveness among themselves and across the organization in general
Advocate on behalf of a position and quickly gain cross-functional alignment on the position
Quickly build credibility and trust with internal stakeholders
Provide strong leadership, communication, and persuasion skills
Lead projects to solve existing commercialization issues

Preferred Qualifications

Direct product launch oversight and experience
Payments industry experience
MBA degree in Business, Technology, Finance, or Economics
Possess a PgMP or PMP certification

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $141,600 - $212,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

At Equinix, talent is a strategic differentiator. As the Program Manager, Global Emerging Talent, you will help shape the workforce of the future by designing and delivering innovative talent solutions that build critical capabilities, accelerate business outcomes, and strengthen long-term talent pipelines.

Reporting Equinix’s Integrated Talent Solutions (ITS), you will serve as a Strategic Talent Advisor and Program Owner, partnering with business leaders, HR, and talent stakeholders to align emerging talent strategies with workforce priorities and future skills needs.

Through a deep understanding of business demand, talent supply, and market dynamics, you will help leaders navigate talent decisions and create pathways that unlock opportunity, build organizational capability, and enable sustainable growth. Leveraging Talent Intelligence, Talent Marketplace capabilities, and Build-Borrow-Buy-Place principles, you will lead the strategy, execution, and evolution of global internship, apprenticeship, and trainee programs that strengthen Equinix's talent ecosystem and deliver measurable business impact.

This role is ideal for a leader who thrives at the intersection of workforce strategy, talent innovation, program execution, and organizational transformation.

Responsibilities

Strategic Talent Advisory

Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders, HR, and Functional Partner Teams, translating workforce demand into innovative talent solutions
Partner with leaders to identify future capability needs and determine how emerging talent programs can accelerate workforce readiness and business growth
Advise on workforce strategies using Build-Borrow-Buy-Place principles, helping leaders balance immediate hiring needs with long-term capability development
Leverage talent intelligence, labor market insights, and workforce data to inform decision-making, talent planning, and investment priorities
Influence talent decisions through a skills-based lens, ensuring alignment between business objectives and future workforce requirements

Global Emerging Talent Strategy

Develop and execute the global strategy for internships, apprenticeships, traineeships, and other emerging talent pathways
Identify opportunities to expand and modernize talent pipelines to meet evolving business and skills demands
Create scalable frameworks, governance models, and operating rhythms that enable consistent global delivery while supporting regional requirements
Drive continuous innovation in how Equinix attracts, develops, and converts emerging talent into future organizational capability

Program Leadership & Delivery

Own the end-to-end lifecycle of global emerging talent programs, from strategy and planning through execution, measurement, and continuous improvement
Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives involving HR, Talent Acquisition, Talent Marketplace, HR Operations, Finance, Communications, Legal, and business stakeholders
Establish success metrics, reporting frameworks, and dashboards that demonstrate program effectiveness, talent outcomes, and business value
Ensure programs are delivered with operational excellence, within budget, on schedule, and aligned with strategic objectives

Talent Marketplace & Skills-Based Talent Solutions

Partner closely with Talent Marketplace and workforce planning stakeholders to integrate emerging talent pathways into broader talent strategies
Enable skills-based talent practices by connecting program design to future capabilities, workforce priorities, and business outcomes
Create pathways that support long-term career growth, internal mobility, and workforce sustainability
Identify opportunities to connect emerging talent initiatives with enterprise transformation and workforce planning efforts

Stakeholder Engagement & Influence

Build trusted partnerships with leaders across the business, Human Resources, and Integrated Talent Solutions
Influence decision-making by translating complex workforce challenges into clear, actionable talent strategies
Deliver compelling executive communications, recommendations, and presentations to senior leaders and governance forums
Act as a visible advocate for emerging talent, workforce innovation, and skills-based talent strategies across the enterprise

Change Leadership

Lead change initiatives associated with talent transformation and workforce innovation efforts
Develop stakeholder engagement, communication, and adoption strategies that drive successful implementation and sustainable outcomes
Foster alignment across global teams and create momentum around new ways of building and developing talent

What Success Looks Like

Emerging talent programs are recognized as strategic workforce solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes
Leaders view Emerging Talent as a trusted partner in workforce planning and capability-building conversations
Talent pipelines are aligned to future skill needs and business priorities
Program participants successfully transition into high-impact roles that strengthen organizational capability
Data, talent intelligence, and workforce insights consistently inform decisions and investment strategies
The programs contribute meaningfully to Equinix's workforce of the future strategy and culture of continuous learning

Qualifications

Required

7+ years of experience leading enterprise-wide programs, workforce initiatives, or talent strategies in Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Workforce Planning, Talent Management, or related functions
Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders to influence strategy, drive change, and deliver business outcomes
Experience managing complex, global, cross-functional programs and organizational initiatives
Strong program management, stakeholder management, and change leadership capabilities
Excellent executive communication, facilitation, and consulting skills
Ability to translate workforce challenges into scalable talent solutions
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Preferred

Experience building, scaling, or optimizing internship, apprenticeship, trainee, or other emerging talent programs
Experience with Talent Marketplace, workforce planning, talent intelligence, talent mobility, or skills-based workforce practices
Knowledge of Build-Borrow-Buy-Place and strategic workforce planning methodologies
Experience operating within complex, global organizations undergoing transformation
Program, project management, agile, or change management certifications

Why Join Us

This role is an opportunity to influence how Equinix builds the workforce of tomorrow. You will help shape talent strategies that create access to opportunity, strengthen critical capabilities, and enable the business to thrive in a rapidly evolving world. You won't simply manage talent programs. You'll help design the future talent ecosystem of Equinix, creating pathways that connect people, skills, and business opportunity at a global scale.

jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

At Equinix, talent is a strategic differentiator. As the Program Manager, Global Emerging Talent, you will help shape the workforce of the future by designing and delivering innovative talent solutions that build critical capabilities, accelerate business outcomes, and strengthen long-term talent pipelines.

Reporting Equinix’s Integrated Talent Solutions (ITS), you will serve as a Strategic Talent Advisor and Program Owner, partnering with business leaders, HR, and talent stakeholders to align emerging talent strategies with workforce priorities and future skills needs.

Through a deep understanding of business demand, talent supply, and market dynamics, you will help leaders navigate talent decisions and create pathways that unlock opportunity, build organizational capability, and enable sustainable growth. Leveraging Talent Intelligence, Talent Marketplace capabilities, and Build-Borrow-Buy-Place principles, you will lead the strategy, execution, and evolution of global internship, apprenticeship, and trainee programs that strengthen Equinix's talent ecosystem and deliver measurable business impact.

This role is ideal for a leader who thrives at the intersection of workforce strategy, talent innovation, program execution, and organizational transformation.

Responsibilities

Strategic Talent Advisory

Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders, HR, and Functional Partner Teams, translating workforce demand into innovative talent solutions
Partner with leaders to identify future capability needs and determine how emerging talent programs can accelerate workforce readiness and business growth
Advise on workforce strategies using Build-Borrow-Buy-Place principles, helping leaders balance immediate hiring needs with long-term capability development
Leverage talent intelligence, labor market insights, and workforce data to inform decision-making, talent planning, and investment priorities
Influence talent decisions through a skills-based lens, ensuring alignment between business objectives and future workforce requirements

Global Emerging Talent Strategy

Develop and execute the global strategy for internships, apprenticeships, traineeships, and other emerging talent pathways
Identify opportunities to expand and modernize talent pipelines to meet evolving business and skills demands
Create scalable frameworks, governance models, and operating rhythms that enable consistent global delivery while supporting regional requirements
Drive continuous innovation in how Equinix attracts, develops, and converts emerging talent into future organizational capability

Program Leadership & Delivery

Own the end-to-end lifecycle of global emerging talent programs, from strategy and planning through execution, measurement, and continuous improvement
Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives involving HR, Talent Acquisition, Talent Marketplace, HR Operations, Finance, Communications, Legal, and business stakeholders
Establish success metrics, reporting frameworks, and dashboards that demonstrate program effectiveness, talent outcomes, and business value
Ensure programs are delivered with operational excellence, within budget, on schedule, and aligned with strategic objectives

Talent Marketplace & Skills-Based Talent Solutions

Partner closely with Talent Marketplace and workforce planning stakeholders to integrate emerging talent pathways into broader talent strategies
Enable skills-based talent practices by connecting program design to future capabilities, workforce priorities, and business outcomes
Create pathways that support long-term career growth, internal mobility, and workforce sustainability
Identify opportunities to connect emerging talent initiatives with enterprise transformation and workforce planning efforts

Stakeholder Engagement & Influence

Build trusted partnerships with leaders across the business, Human Resources, and Integrated Talent Solutions
Influence decision-making by translating complex workforce challenges into clear, actionable talent strategies
Deliver compelling executive communications, recommendations, and presentations to senior leaders and governance forums
Act as a visible advocate for emerging talent, workforce innovation, and skills-based talent strategies across the enterprise

Change Leadership

Lead change initiatives associated with talent transformation and workforce innovation efforts
Develop stakeholder engagement, communication, and adoption strategies that drive successful implementation and sustainable outcomes
Foster alignment across global teams and create momentum around new ways of building and developing talent

What Success Looks Like

Emerging talent programs are recognized as strategic workforce solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes
Leaders view Emerging Talent as a trusted partner in workforce planning and capability-building conversations
Talent pipelines are aligned to future skill needs and business priorities
Program participants successfully transition into high-impact roles that strengthen organizational capability
Data, talent intelligence, and workforce insights consistently inform decisions and investment strategies
The programs contribute meaningfully to Equinix's workforce of the future strategy and culture of continuous learning

Qualifications

Required

7+ years of experience leading enterprise-wide programs, workforce initiatives, or talent strategies in Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Workforce Planning, Talent Management, or related functions
Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders to influence strategy, drive change, and deliver business outcomes
Experience managing complex, global, cross-functional programs and organizational initiatives
Strong program management, stakeholder management, and change leadership capabilities
Excellent executive communication, facilitation, and consulting skills
Ability to translate workforce challenges into scalable talent solutions
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Preferred

Experience building, scaling, or optimizing internship, apprenticeship, trainee, or other emerging talent programs
Experience with Talent Marketplace, workforce planning, talent intelligence, talent mobility, or skills-based workforce practices
Knowledge of Build-Borrow-Buy-Place and strategic workforce planning methodologies
Experience operating within complex, global organizations undergoing transformation
Program, project management, agile, or change management certifications

Why Join Us

This role is an opportunity to influence how Equinix builds the workforce of tomorrow. You will help shape talent strategies that create access to opportunity, strengthen critical capabilities, and enable the business to thrive in a rapidly evolving world. You won't simply manage talent programs. You'll help design the future talent ecosystem of Equinix, creating pathways that connect people, skills, and business opportunity at a global scale.

Alberta Transportation and Economic Corridors (TEC) is a centre of excellence for transportation in North America. We contribute to Alberta's prosperity and quality of life by providing and supporting a safe, innovative and sustainable provincial transportation system and water management infrastructure. With Alberta Transportation and Economic Corridors, you can engage in a fulfilling career with diverse room to grow. We believe in building careers, providing opportunities for growth within the organization, and striving to provide our staff with a work-life balance including reasonable hours of work to ensure time with family and to accommodate outside interests.

The Ministry Promotes a Vital And Diverse Economy By

Managing transportation safety.
Supporting municipalities with public transportation and water/wastewater facilities.
Expanding and enhancing a well-integrated transportation system and enabling market access.
Preserving and developing the provincial highway network and water management infrastructure.

For more information, visit https://www.alberta.ca/transportation-and-economic-corridors .

Role Responsibilities

This position reports to the Manager, Data and Analytics within the Modernization and Business Intelligence unit of Motor Vehicle Modernization branch of Traffic Safety Services (TSS) division of TEC. The Senior Data Analyst leads the analysis of complex traffic safety datasets and extracts key insights and interpretations to drive evidence-based policy and business decision making.

The primary responsibilities for the Senior Data Analyst include, but are not limited to:

Advanced Data Analysis and Comprehension
Lead complex data analysis projects by applying advanced statistical methods and techniques to extract actionable insights.
Identify emerging trends or patterns in traffic safety data and investigate contributing factors to help inform policy decisions.
Strategic Data Reporting and Dashboards
Design, develop, and maintain advanced reporting systems and interactive dashboards that support performance measurement, program evaluation, and decision - making.
Ensure that reports and dashboards provide real-time, actionable insights, are user-friendly, and align with departmental goals and outcomes.
Predictive and Prescriptive Analytics
Utilize predictive modeling, machine learning, natural language processing techniques and other advanced analytical techniques to forecast future trends, assess risks, and develop prescriptive recommendations.
Lead initiatives that leverage data analytics to optimize program delivery and improve service outcomes within Traffic Safety Services operations.
Data Governance and Standards
Lead the implementation of data governance frameworks, ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and consistent across government systems.
Develop and enforce best practices for data quality assurance, ensuring data integrity, security, and privacy across all analytical initiatives.
Policy Development and Evaluation
Provide data-driven insights to inform the development of policies, regulations, and strategic initiatives.
Participate in government working groups and committees, providing expert level analytical support to evaluate the effectiveness and impact of traffic safety programs using rigorous data analysis methods, recommending improvements based on findings.

The Successful Candidate Will Have

Proven ability to manage complex data projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely delivery, quality control, and alignment with business objectives.
Strong project management skills, including managing resources, timelines, and deliverables across multiple teams and departments.
In-depth understanding of public sector operations and government program structures, with the ability to tailor data analysis to inform program performance and policy development.
The ability to evaluate the effectiveness of government initiatives, identify gaps, and propose data-driven solutions for improvement.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present data findings to a wide range of audiences, from technical teams to senior executives and government officials.
Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate with various departments and stakeholders, influencing decision-making through data-driven insights.
Proven leadership ability to mentor and guide junior data analysts, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development.

The Job Description is provided for Further details on this position.

APS Competencies

Competencies are behaviors that are essential to reach our goals in serving Albertans. We encourage you to have an in depth understanding of the competencies that are required for this opportunity and to be prepared to demonstrate them during the recruitment process.

Systems Thinking – Takes a long-term view towards organization’s objectives and how to achieve them: Senior Data Analyst has a well-rounded and deep understanding of TEC's 48 technology applications and the data sets within each and the interrelationships between the data sets.
Creative Problem Solving – Engages the community and resources at hand to address issues: Develops compelling insights and recommendations through creative storytelling and data visuals that meet the needs of non-technical senior leaders.
Develop Networks – Works on maintaining close relations with all stakeholders: Actively develops connections and influences others through the course of their duties.
Develop Self and Others – Plans according to career goals and regular development: The SDA takes a life long learning approach to data analysis and learns new techniques and data analysis software as it becomes available.

Qualifications

Required:

University graduation in Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Intelligence, Analytics or a related field PLUS Four (4) years’ progressively responsible related experience

Equivalency: Related experience or education (e.g. related diploma) may be considered as an equivalency on a one for one basis

Assets

Master’s degree preferred. Strong project management skills, including managing resources, timelines, and deliverables across multiple teams and departments.
Proficiency in advanced data visualization tools and reporting platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to create interactive dashboards and reports. The hiring team would prefer to see a copy of candidate’s portfolio of previous work/dashboards. (Not mandatory)
Expertise in statistical Modeling, regression analysis, time series forecasting, Clustering, and multivariate analysis. Proficiency in applying machine learning algorithms and advanced analytics techniques (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning) to solve complex problems.
Expertise in SQL for querying, analyzing, and manipulating large datasets from relational databases. Proficiency in using programming languages for data analysis (e.g., Python or R)
Strong ability to use visualization techniques to communicate insights clearly and effectively to senior leadership and external stakeholders.
Ability to interpret and present complex, actionable insights and analytical results (via visualizations, written reports and KPIs) to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong experience with data quality management, including data cleansing, validation, cataloging, and monitoring for data integrity.
Proven ability to manage complex data projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely delivery, quality control, and alignment with business objectives.
Strong knowledge of data management principles, including data governance, metadata management, and data integration across diverse sources (e.g., databases, APIs).
Deep understanding of data governance frameworks and best practices, ensuring data privacy, security, and compliance with relevant legislation and regulation such as the
Access to Information Act (ATIA), the Protection of Privacy Act (POPA) and the Access to Motor Vehicle Information Regulation (AMVIR).

jobs.title: Technology Leadership Program - Risk & Security Analyst (PA) NEW
jobs.description:
Technology is the enabling force powering Vanguard’s client experience, investment products, and advice. As technology continues to evolve, so does the need for leaders who can identify, assess, and mitigate risk across complex systems. Vanguard’s Technology Leadership Program (TLP) is designed to develop the next generation of IT leaders through hands-on experience, collaboration, and rotational learning. Through three unique rotations, you will build technical expertise in cybersecurity and risk while developing the leadership skills needed to protect Vanguard and its clients.

Protect What Matters Most

At Vanguard, we’re committed to doing what’s right for our clients - and that starts with protecting their data, assets, and trust. As part of the Technology Leadership Program in the Risk & Security Analyst track, you’ll help identify, assess, and mitigate risks that impact Vanguard’s systems, operations, and clients. Your work will contribute to safeguarding Vanguard against evolving cybersecurity threats and operational risks. Through real-world assignments and collaboration across technology and business teams, you’ll gain exposure to how risk and security practices enable Vanguard to deliver secure, reliable services to investors.

Are you a self-starter who thrives on solving complex challenges and thinking critically about risk? Join a team where innovation is driven by purpose. You’ll work alongside cybersecurity, technology, and business partners to analyze threats, strengthen controls, and support risk-informed decision-making. Through technical capstones, hackathons, and hands-on projects, you’ll build both your analytical skillset and your ability to collaborate, influence, and lead. 

The Technology Leadership Program is a two-year rotational development experience designed for graduating students ready to begin their careers in technology. Participants complete three eight-month rotations across Risk & Security-focused teams, gaining exposure to different areas such as cybersecurity operations, threat intelligence, risk management, and identity & access management - while increasing ownership, responsibility, and leadership capability over time.

In this program, you will: 

Support efforts to identify, assess, and mitigate cybersecurity and operational risks
Analyze potential threats, vulnerabilities, and risk scenarios across systems and processes
Contribute to reporting, dashboards, or insights that support risk-informed decision-making
Partner with security, technology, and business teams to strengthen controls and processes
Gain hands-on experience in risk management, cybersecurity frameworks, and digital ethics
Apply Agile methodologies to support risk and security initiatives in a dynamic environment
Take ownership of projects and contribute to delivering meaningful outcomes
Collaborate across teams, share insights, and drive solutions in a supportive environment
Build a network with program managers, alumni, senior leaders, and peers
Meet regularly with your department manager and program manager to receive personalized coaching and mentorship 

What it takes: 

Bachelor's or Master's degree with a concentration in computer science, computer engineering, IST, IT, CIS, Security, Risk, Cybersecurity or related technical/engineering subject matter required 
Strong interest in cybersecurity, threat analysis, risk management, or fraud prevention
Demonstrated leadership potential, initiative, and ability to take ownership of work
Strong analytical, communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative, team-oriented environment
Cumulative GPA of 3.2 or higher preferred

Special Factors 

Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position. 
This position will begin in 2027 and students graduating in December 2026 or Spring 2027 are encouraged to apply. 

Our Total Rewards package reflects our commitment to you and your family’s well-being – both for today and for the future. We invest in your financial, physical, and personal success with best-in-class benefits through:

Pay for performance, including annual performance bonuses, merit increases, and an annual Partnership bonus. 
Industry-leading retirement savings plans: 
401(k) contribution 55% above the national average. 
Quarterly 401(k) contribution of 10% of your eligible pay. 
At least 18 paid days off, plus 10 federal holidays. 
77% of your medical costs are covered, compared to 68% by other financial services companies. 
Unparalleled Health Savings Account (HSA) seed and match – 5x the amount as other contributing employers. 
A $1500 FlexFund annual stipend for personally meaningful conveniences – 3x the average amount offered by other employers. 
Top-tier programs for your emotional and mental health: 
Access to 2x more coaching and therapy sessions compared to other employers. 
A caregiving concierge program, something only one in five employers offer. 

Special Factors

Sponsorship

Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.

About Vanguard

At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission.

To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best.

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

jobs.description:
More Time Off for What Matters: Enjoy up to 6 weeks of leave

Hybrid office/work-from-home environment

Senior role with opportunity to influence investment outcomes

Perpetual Wealth

The wealth management business consists of three distinct brands in addition to Perpetual Private - Fordham, Jacaranda Financial Planning and Priority Life - offering a unique mix of wealth management, advice and trustee services. With a diverse range of capabilities including strategic advice on superannuation and retirement planning, general investment, asset protection, insurance, tax management, estate planning, aged care, social security, succession planning and philanthropy. Our clients include individuals, families, businesses, not-for-profit organisations, and Indigenous communities throughout Australia.

About the role

As a key member of the Perpetual Private Investment Research team, you will contribute to the management of multi-manager Real Assets and Growth Asset classes strategies, including private markets, while supporting broader growth asset class research. You'll research investment managers and opportunities, contribute to portfolio design and management, and help deliver high-quality investment outcomes and solutions for clients. Experience in other asset classes will also be considered.

Role responsibilities include:

Research, assess and recommend investment managers and opportunities across Real Assets, Equities, Growth Alternatives and Responsible Investment strategies.

Monitor and maintain the Approved Product List (APL) and contribute to portfolio construction and manager selection decisions.

Support the design, review and ongoing management of implemented and model portfolios.

Prepare and present investment research and recommendations to Investment Committees and contribute to Board and committee papers.

Participate in strategic and dynamic asset allocation discussions and contribute to Perpetual Private's investment strategy and House View.

Deliver investment communications, presentations and technical support to advisers and clients.

About you

Relevant tertiary qualification in Commerce, Economics, Business, Finance, Science, Mathematics or a related discipline.

Postgraduate investment qualifications such as CFA, CAIA, MBA or Master of Applied Finance.

5-10+ years' experience in investment research, preferably within a multi-manager or dealer group environment.

Demonstrated experience across Real Estate, Infrastructure, Equities, Growth Alternatives or related asset classes.

Strong portfolio construction, analytical, modelling and quantitative skills, with knowledge of ESG and Responsible Investing principles.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work independently and take ownership of investment decisions.

How we work

Our unique culture is underpinned by our three organisational behaviours, Stretch, Own it, Make an impact which drive our approach of day-to-day interactions with colleagues and clients, the way we approach decision-making to the questions we ask and the problems we solve.

Employee benefits

Work from anywhere in Australia for up to one month each year
An annual allowance to empower you to prioritise your personal wellbeing
Study support and commitment to supporting professional development
We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is celebrated. No matter your background or circumstances, we aim to provide an environment where you can thrive.

jobs.description:
Overview

Hexagon’s Autonomous Solutions division is looking for a Project Manager - Global Business Services (GBS)
to join our team in Calgary, Canada
. Reporting to the appropriate GBS leadership team, this role will lead and deliver cross-functional projects across Finance, HR, IT, Legal, Compliance, and other business functions, ensuring successful execution, governance, and adoption of scalable business solutions within a global environment.

The Location:
 This position is based in Calgary, Canada.

The Company:
Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality, and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous, ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Responsibilities

As  Project Manager - Global Business Services (GBS)
 you will be responsible for these activities:

Apply GBS PMO standards and governance practices across projects and initiatives.
Lead end-to-end project delivery, including planning, scope definition, execution, governance, and project closure.
Manage project timelines, budgets, dependencies, risks, resources, and deliverables to ensure successful outcomes.
Develop robust project plans capable of adapting to implementation challenges and evolving business requirements.
Drive process improvement, systems implementation, governance, compliance, and business transformation initiatives across GBS functions.
Partner with stakeholders across Finance, HR, IT, Legal, Compliance, Security, and external vendors to deliver scalable business solutions.
Develop business cases, cost-benefit analyses, ROI assessments, and project performance reporting.
Manage project risks, issues, change management activities, and stakeholder communications throughout the project lifecycle.
Support portfolio management, resource planning, and prioritization across multiple concurrent projects.
Integrate change management and communications planning throughout the full project lifecycle.
Provide executive-level project reporting, dashboards, presentations, and recommendations to leadership teams.
Mentor project managers and promote project management best practices across the organization.
Support data governance and reporting initiatives to improve visibility, efficiency, cost control, and decision-making.

Qualifications

Must Have:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.
PMP certification or equivalent project management qualification preferred.
5+ years of project management experience within a PMO, shared services, or enterprise environment.
Proven experience leading large, complex, cross-functional projects and programs.
Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, governance frameworks, and delivery practices.
Experience managing project budgets, business cases, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.
Ability to work effectively with senior leaders and influence stakeholders across all organizational levels.
Strong communication, presentation, leadership, negotiation, and change management skills.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced global environment.
Experience working within regulated, risk-sensitive environments while handling confidential information.

Nice To Have:

Experience delivering projects using Agile, Scrum, Design Thinking, MVP, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
Experience with legal operations, compliance programs, governance frameworks, legal technology platforms, or legal spend management.
Experience leading enterprise-wide system implementations, cloud migrations, or application consolidation initiatives.
Exposure to system integrations, process automation, and data governance projects.

Key Success Factors:

Ability to translate complex or ambiguous business challenges into structured, actionable project plans.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and build trusted partnerships.
Proactive, organized, and results-oriented approach to project delivery.
Strong commercial acumen with a focus on business value, efficiency, and measurable outcomes.
Ability to identify risks early and implement practical mitigation strategies.
Commitment to continuous improvement, governance excellence, and operational discipline.

jobs.description:
HKT Digital Ventures builds a growth model with an integrated digital ecosystem consisting of business verticals ranging from e-Commerce, insurance, digital health, travel to FinTech services. Leveraged by high profiling loyalty program and big data of high future visibility, we run a very successful and promising digital ecosystem in Hong Kong.

Your role:

Translate group-wide commercial goals into quantitative analytical frameworks, using unified customer data across Telecom, Financial Services, and Digital Health / Insurance to maximize Customer Lifetime Value (CLV).
Conduct deep-dive customer profiling and multi-dimensional segmentation to map cross-pillar journey touchpoints and tier progression.
Identify high-value cross-selling and up-selling pathways to expand multi-product holding across the group.
Build and maintain holistic executive scorecards, KPI frameworks, and BI dashboards to monitor core loyalty health metrics
Evaluate customer campaign effectiveness across acquisition, engagement, and retention programs; measure offer redemption elasticity, multi-touch attribution, and ROI.
Formulate and analyze A/B and multivariate experimentation frameworks to drive continuous improvement in member engagement strategies.
Synthesize digital product analytics (web/app clickstream, event payloads) with backend transactional and loyalty data to maintain a true 360-degree customer view.
Implement conversational analytics interfaces and AI-assisted workflows to automate routine reporting, enable natural language querying (NLQ) for business leaders, and establish proactive anomaly detection alerts for rapid decision-making.

To succeed in this role:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
1+ year of hands-on experience in business analytics, BI development, customer/CRM analytics, or digital analytics.
Advanced SQL & Scripting: High proficiency in production-grade SQL and scripting languages like Python or R for data manipulation and statistical analysis.
BI Expertise: Proven ability to design and build high-performance, interactive executive dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
Domain & Funnel Knowledge: Solid understanding of customer acquisition/retention loops, CRM performance metrics, and web/mobile digital user journeys.
Communication & Storytelling: Strong ability to translate complex analytical findings into executive-ready insights and presentation decks for non-technical leadership.
Good command of Cantonese and English.

Do you want to work with other skilled and agile practitioners who thrive on challenge and growth? We believe everyone has untapped potential. It's our hope that you find more than just a job. At Sikich, you'll find optimism, clear insights and genuine warmth, without egos.

Are you ready to grow with us?

Position summary

This is a surge support position through January 15, 2026.
Extension is possible but not guaranteed. The position is hybrid, with the office in Washington, DC, supporting a federal client and requires an active public trust or better clearance. Remote candidates will be considered.

Sikich seeks an experienced Technical Business Analyst and Project Manager to support a federal client infrastructure operations team through dual capabilities: (1) assessing technical and operational workflows to identify automation and AI opportunities, and (2) managing multiple infrastructure and cloud migration initiatives from planning through delivery.

This hybrid role combines process improvement analysis with project delivery coordination. You will assess the team's technical and business processes, document workflows and dependencies, identify gaps and bottlenecks, recommend improvements, manage project schedules and risks, remove delivery roadblocks, and communicate status to leadership. You will work closely with engineering staff, project sponsors, and program leadership to improve service delivery, reduce manual effort, accelerate cloud migration timelines, and create measurable gains in productivity and operational outcomes.

This role requires United States citizenship and a Public Trust. Preference is given to candidates located in the National Capital Region, including Washington, DC, Maryland, and Virginia.

What will you do in this role?

You will combine business analysis and project management to drive infrastructure modernization and operational improvements:

Analysis & Process Improvement

Map and document existing technical and business processes, identifying inefficiencies and automation candidates
Partner with engineering staff to validate findings and help implement approved recommendations
Advise on adoption of Microsoft 365 tools, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot, and related AI capabilities
Develop measurements to report on productivity and outcome improvements resulting from changes
Produce detailed technical and business process workflow documentation

Project Delivery & Coordination

Manage multiple infrastructure projects from planning through delivery
Develop and maintain integrated schedules, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, action items, and decision logs
Manage Jira tickets and Confluence pages for assigned projects and ensure project documentation remains current
Facilitate meetings, document discussions and decisions, assign follow-up actions, and remove delivery roadblocks
Support adoption and refinement of agile and SAFe practices in an infrastructure operations environment
Aggregate technical inputs and publish concise status reports for client and company leadership
Create, edit, review, and coordinate formal project deliverables and presentation materials

What do you need to succeed in this role?

Empathy, patience and professionalism when working directly with end users, including the ability to explain technical steps clearly over remote sessions.
Sound judgment to ask for help, appropriate escalation of issues, and the ability to provide enough technical detail for senior administrators to act quickly.
Basic Excel proficiency for tracking device lists, remediation status, deployment results, and issue trends.
Ticketing system literacy, with ServiceNow and/or JIRA experience helpful but trainable on the job.

Desired Qualifications:

Required background includes hands-on experience in both of the following areas:

Business Analysis & Process Improvement:

8+ years’ experience in project management
7+ years' experience in process analysis, documentation, and process improvement
4+ years' hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and AI capabilities (Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot)
Demonstrated experience documenting current-state and future-state workflows, facilitating working sessions with technical and business stakeholders, developing process maps and standard operating procedures, and translating findings into actionable recommendations
Experience in federal government, regulated, or enterprise IT environments

Project Management & Delivery:

8+ years' total information technology experience
7+ years' experience managing complex IT projects
5+ years' experience in a client-facing role
2+ years' experience supporting federal government or government-contracting environments
Demonstrated infrastructure and/or cloud project management experience
Hands-on, current experience with Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Visio, and Microsoft Office

In compliance with this state’s pay transparency laws, the salary range for this role is $135,000-$145,000. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location.

In addition, successful candidates will bring a service-oriented mindset, clear communication, sound troubleshooting judgment, and the ability to work collaboratively with technical teams and end users in a remote federal client environment.

Servant Leader – You are hyper focused on engaging employees, fostering their development, and building a positive culture.
Solutions Focused – You see opportunities in every business problem and can develop, articulate, and implement solutions.
Collaboration – You are a relationship builder across all levels of the organization and across all business units.
Instills Trust - You do what you say, and you follow through on commitments, you act with integrity, you are consistent and are perceived as credible.
Impact & Influence Thinking – You gain support for ideas, proposals, and solutions, and get others to act, with or without formal authority, to advance initiatives/objectives.

About Sikich,

Sikich, offers the public and private sectors a diverse platform of professional services across consulting, technology, and compliance. Highly specialized and hands-on teams deliver integrated solutions rooted in deep industry experience. Our approach is strategically and thoughtfully designed to help our clients, teams and communities accelerate success.

Description

Are you a seasoned Biology Project Manager looking to help shape the future of habitat restoration and environmental consulting in Southern California? Join HELIX Environmental Planning, an employee-owned firm where your expertise as a Biology Project Manager will directly influence meaningful restoration, conservation, and infrastructure projects across the region. You'll have the opportunity to grow with a thriving Pasadena team while working on projects that span coastal, mountain, and desert ecosystems.

Why HELIX?

HELIX is a full-service environmental consulting and planning firm specializing in biological resources, habitat restoration, regulatory permitting, and environmental compliance. What sets HELIX apart is our ability to design, implement, and monitor restoration projects entirely in-house, from growing native plants to long-term success monitoring. As a Biology Project Manager, you'll join a collaborative, employee-owned organization that values innovation, technical excellence, and professional growth. This position follows a hybrid schedule with three days per week in the office.

Day in the Life

As a Biology Project Manager, you'll lead diverse biological resources projects throughout Southern California. One day you may be guiding habitat restoration planning and coordinating with regulatory agencies; the next you'll be partnering with clients, preparing technical reports, managing project teams, and supporting business development efforts. The Biology Project Manager role offers the perfect blend of project leadership, client engagement, strategic planning, and occasional field involvement. You'll play a key role in expanding HELIX's restoration and biology presence throughout the Los Angeles region.

What You'll Do

Serve as a Biology Project Manager for biological resources and habitat restoration projects.
Lead regulatory permitting efforts and agency consultation.
Prepare and oversee biological technical reports and restoration plans.
Manage environmental review support and biological resources analysis.
Build and maintain strong client and agency relationships.
Coordinate project teams, schedules, budgets, and deliverables.
Prepare proposals and support business development activities.
Develop creative solutions to complex project challenges.
Collaborate across disciplines to achieve successful project outcomes.
Occasionally conduct biological fieldwork as needed.

Salary will be based on qualifications and/or experience, with a robust benefits package. Expected starting pay range of $91,000 to $115,000.

Solid experience with programming in Python

Demonstrated ability to analyze complex datasets and derive actionable conclusions
Experience with experimentation design, execution, analysis in a LiveOps environment
Understanding of data and how it translates to unique player experiences
Comprehension of core KPI impact on product performance, especially when it comes to engagement, retention and monetization
Experience with database schema design

Job Description

Staff Program Intelligence Analyst

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard – from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.

Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.

The Role

We’re seeking a strategic, hands-on Staff-level individual contributor to set direction and deliver the future of Program Intelligence, analytics, and AI across the Program Management organization. This role operates at the intersection of enterprise data strategy, storytelling, and portfolio execution — enabling senior leadership to make faster, smarter decisions through trusted, high-quality, actionable insights. The successful candidate will work with broad autonomy, navigate significant ambiguity, and influence outcomes across organizational boundaries without direct authority.

You will define and advance the Program Intelligence strategy, establishing scalable patterns, standards, and governance for data products (dashboards, AI Agents, web applications, and analytics pipelines). You’ll work directly with PMO leaders and cross-functional partners to deliver high-impact, customer-facing capabilities and narratives that connect data to business outcomes. You will also raise the capability of the broader organization through mentoring, coaching, and reusable practices while remaining an individual contributor.

Why This Role Matters

GM’s vehicle portfolio is evolving faster than ever and demands sharper insight and tighter alignment across the enterprise. This role defines how Program Management measures what matters — turning data into the connective tissue between strategy, capacity, and execution. The impact of this role extends beyond individual deliverables: it establishes the intelligence capabilities, decision frameworks, and operating standards that enable leaders and teams to execute with greater clarity and speed.

What You’ll Do

Set the Program Intelligence & Reporting Strategy: Define and evolve the long-term vision, principles, operating model, and architecture for management information, reporting, analytics, and dashboards that support portfolio, capacity, and delivery decision-making.
Lead portfolio-scale data products: Direct the design and delivery of trusted, decision-grade dashboards, AI Agents, web applications, and reports that establish a durable source of truth for program health, capacity, and delivery performance.
Establish metrics and data governance: Create common definitions, measurement frameworks, data quality expectations, and governance practices that improve consistency, comparability, and confidence in enterprise decisions.
Architect analytics and AI solutions: Translate ambiguous, high-impact business needs into scalable data models, analytical products, AI-driven solutions, and reusable technical patterns in partnership with data engineering, IT, and product teams.
Influence executive decisions: Synthesize complex data and competing perspectives into clear narratives, recommendations, and decision frameworks that drive alignment and action at the senior leadership level.
Drive adoption and measurable value: Champion the use of Program Intelligence capabilities, assess adoption and business impact, and continuously improve products and practices based on customer feedback and evolving portfolio needs.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of progressive experience in business intelligence, analytics, data products, management reporting, or a related discipline, including experience leading complex, enterprise-level initiatives.
Advanced experience with SQL, Python, cloud analytics platforms (e.g., Databricks, AWS), and the development or application of AI-driven solutions in an enterprise environment.
Demonstrated success defining strategy and delivering scalable dashboards, reporting products, data pipelines, analytics platforms, or AI-enabled experiences using modern tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Databricks, or equivalent technologies.
Proven ability to connect metrics to business strategy and portfolio outcomes, translating operational data into executive-level insights, recommendations, and decision frameworks.
Exceptional communication, visualization, facilitation, and data storytelling skills, with the ability to influence senior audiences and align stakeholders around complex decisions.
Recognized as a trusted advisor and thought leader who collaborates and influences across technical, product, and business stakeholders, aligns diverse perspectives around shared metrics and insights, and delivers results without direct authority.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

MBA or advanced degree in business, data science, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative discipline.
Background in large-scale technology, product, engineering, or enterprise transformation environments, with experience scaling data-driven decision frameworks and operating models.
Deep knowledge of data science, machine learning, generative AI, responsible AI, and the practical application of these capabilities to enterprise decision-making.
Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous, enterprise-wide business needs into structured intelligence strategies, governed metrics, scalable reporting systems, and insight-driven products with measurable adoption and impact.

Hybrid or Remote:
This role is categorized as hybrid for those within commutable distance. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to our Engineering Technical Center in Warren (MI) or Austin (TX) three times per week at minimum otherwise open to virtual.

Compensation:
The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The compensation may not be representative for positions located outside of the California Bay Area.

The salary range for this role is $134,700 to $245,00. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.

Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance.

Benefits:
GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more.

Upon successful completion of a motor vehicle report review, you will be eligible to participate in a company vehicle evaluation program, through which you will be assigned a General Motors vehicle to drive and evaluate. Note: program participants are required to purchase/lease a qualifying GM vehicle every four years unless one of a limited number of exceptions applies.

This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc).

We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.

About ITC  

Join ITC, a trailblazing force with offices in Shanghai, Singapore, Hong Kong, France and Saigon. We are a hub of innovation for Fortune 500 companies and industry leaders, guiding them through the complexities of the Chinese and APAC markets.  
At ITC, you’ll play a pivotal role in transforming their business landscapes using cutting-edge MarTech, e-Commerce, and Omnichannel solutions. As part of our team, you’ll not only witness but also contribute to significant ROI achievements and market successes. We’re not just navigating the future of digital commerce; we’re creating it. Be a part of our journey to redefine industry standards and elevate market experiences across Asia. 
With a talented team of 60 professionals across APAC, our 2024 milestones include: 
Orchestrating 30+ digital transformation workshops for global leaders like Coty, LVMH, and Unilever Prestige 
Empowering 5,000+ Sales Associates across luxury brands like Moncler, Margiela, Moschino, and Christies with comprehensive omnichannel training programs and change management 
Spearheading Salesforce Commerce Cloud implementations for luxury brands in China, notably with LVMH and other fashion groups 
Driving eCommerce growth with bespoke website development for clients like Brandy Melville and Hublot 
Scaling fast fashion to 10,000+ daily orders with optimized e-commerce solutions 
Igniting sales for Hublot, Omega, and Fred via high-performing Mini Programs in China 
Expanding The Hour Glass’s presence across 9 APAC markets with integrated solutions. 

What You Will Get Out of This Position  

As a Project Manager, you will own end-to-end delivery of brand websites and digital platforms for enterprise clients. This is a client-facing, leadership role where your ability to communicate clearly, challenge design decisions, and sell solutions matters more than technical depth. You will manage cross-functional teams, drive stakeholder alignment, and ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and at the quality level clients expect.

Responsibilities: 

Lead full lifecycle delivery of brand website and digital platform projects, from discovery through post-launch support.
Lead multidisciplinary teams of 5+ members including designers, developers (front- and backend), QA engineers, and analysts.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and meet high-quality standards and business goals.
Define and oversee scope, timelines, budgets, resourcing, and risk management strategies.
Serve as the main point of contact for clients, managing expectations, scope, and change requests.
Negotiate timelines and budgets with clients while ensuring profitability and operational feasibility.
Conduct stakeholder meetings, workshops, and presentations to ensure alignment on vision, priorities, and deliverables.
Articulate and sell solutions clearly to clients, translating business needs into actionable project proposals.
Review and challenge design decisions with a critical eye: page structure, component logic, responsive behavior, and UX flows.
Collaborate with designers and developers to ensure creative output meets client expectations and brand standards.
Work with internal stakeholders to optimize resource planning, project assignments, and workload balancing.
Mentor junior project managers and team leads, fostering a culture of accountability and excellence.

Requirements 

Must have: 

5-6+ years of experience in project management, with proven delivery of brand/corporate website projects.
Strong UX/UI literacy: ability to review designs critically, challenge decisions (e.g., hierarchy, layout logic, component structure), and ensure design quality without being a designer.
Excellent communication skills: sharp, clear, and persuasive in both written and verbal English.
Ability to conduct pre-sales presentations and clearly explain solutions in front of clients.
Experience managing and communicating at senior and executive levels.
Excellent understanding of web and mobile application development lifecycle.
Proven ability to manage both business expectations and technical realities.
Experience leading diverse project teams and navigating fast-paced, client-driven environments.
Ability to engage and partner with clients and internal staff as required.
Ability to work in a multicultural team across different time zones.
Ability to identify problems and work to resolution proactively.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and tools like Jira, Confluence, Figma, or Miro.

Nice to have: 

Experience delivering eCommerce projects (full project from 0 to 1 is a strong plus).
Familiarity with CMS platforms such as WordPress or Drupal.
Experience with app delivery (iOS/Android) or mini-app platforms (WeChat, Zalo).
Experience with CRM/Salesforce implementation or MarTech projects.
Knowledge of headless architecture or API-first approaches (conceptual, not hands-on).
Additional language (French, Chinese)

The Package 

Flexible paid days off and more 
Employment and insurance benefits above the market 
Professional career path and frequently objectives, review 
Lovely office with modern facilities 
Fun and dynamic team with great ambition, always fight for the same goal 
Other exciting team building activities
