Role Responsibilities

This position reports to the Manager, Data and Analytics within the Modernization and Business Intelligence unit of Motor Vehicle Modernization branch of Traffic Safety Services (TSS) division of TEC. The Senior Data Analyst leads the analysis of complex traffic safety datasets and extracts key insights and interpretations to drive evidence-based policy and business decision making.

The primary responsibilities for the Senior Data Analyst include, but are not limited to:

Advanced Data Analysis and Comprehension
Lead complex data analysis projects by applying advanced statistical methods and techniques to extract actionable insights.
Identify emerging trends or patterns in traffic safety data and investigate contributing factors to help inform policy decisions.
Strategic Data Reporting and Dashboards
Design, develop, and maintain advanced reporting systems and interactive dashboards that support performance measurement, program evaluation, and decision - making.
Ensure that reports and dashboards provide real-time, actionable insights, are user-friendly, and align with departmental goals and outcomes.
Predictive and Prescriptive Analytics
Utilize predictive modeling, machine learning, natural language processing techniques and other advanced analytical techniques to forecast future trends, assess risks, and develop prescriptive recommendations.
Lead initiatives that leverage data analytics to optimize program delivery and improve service outcomes within Traffic Safety Services operations.
Data Governance and Standards
Lead the implementation of data governance frameworks, ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and consistent across government systems.
Develop and enforce best practices for data quality assurance, ensuring data integrity, security, and privacy across all analytical initiatives.
Policy Development and Evaluation
Provide data-driven insights to inform the development of policies, regulations, and strategic initiatives.
Participate in government working groups and committees, providing expert level analytical support to evaluate the effectiveness and impact of traffic safety programs using rigorous data analysis methods, recommending improvements based on findings.

The Successful Candidate Will Have

Proven ability to manage complex data projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely delivery, quality control, and alignment with business objectives.
Strong project management skills, including managing resources, timelines, and deliverables across multiple teams and departments.
In-depth understanding of public sector operations and government program structures, with the ability to tailor data analysis to inform program performance and policy development.
The ability to evaluate the effectiveness of government initiatives, identify gaps, and propose data-driven solutions for improvement.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present data findings to a wide range of audiences, from technical teams to senior executives and government officials.
Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate with various departments and stakeholders, influencing decision-making through data-driven insights.
Proven leadership ability to mentor and guide junior data analysts, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development.

The Job Description is provided for Further details on this position.

APS Competencies

Competencies are behaviors that are essential to reach our goals in serving Albertans. We encourage you to have an in depth understanding of the competencies that are required for this opportunity and to be prepared to demonstrate them during the recruitment process.

Systems Thinking – Takes a long-term view towards organization’s objectives and how to achieve them: Senior Data Analyst has a well-rounded and deep understanding of TEC's 48 technology applications and the data sets within each and the interrelationships between the data sets.
Creative Problem Solving – Engages the community and resources at hand to address issues: Develops compelling insights and recommendations through creative storytelling and data visuals that meet the needs of non-technical senior leaders.
Develop Networks – Works on maintaining close relations with all stakeholders: Actively develops connections and influences others through the course of their duties.
Develop Self and Others – Plans according to career goals and regular development: The SDA takes a life long learning approach to data analysis and learns new techniques and data analysis software as it becomes available.

Qualifications

Required:

University graduation in Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Intelligence, Analytics or a related field PLUS Four (4) years’ progressively responsible related experience

Equivalency: Related experience or education (e.g. related diploma) may be considered as an equivalency on a one for one basis

Assets

Master’s degree preferred. Strong project management skills, including managing resources, timelines, and deliverables across multiple teams and departments.
Proficiency in advanced data visualization tools and reporting platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to create interactive dashboards and reports. The hiring team would prefer to see a copy of candidate’s portfolio of previous work/dashboards. (Not mandatory)
Expertise in statistical Modeling, regression analysis, time series forecasting, Clustering, and multivariate analysis. Proficiency in applying machine learning algorithms and advanced analytics techniques (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning) to solve complex problems.
Expertise in SQL for querying, analyzing, and manipulating large datasets from relational databases. Proficiency in using programming languages for data analysis (e.g., Python or R)
Strong ability to use visualization techniques to communicate insights clearly and effectively to senior leadership and external stakeholders.
Ability to interpret and present complex, actionable insights and analytical results (via visualizations, written reports and KPIs) to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong experience with data quality management, including data cleansing, validation, cataloging, and monitoring for data integrity.
Proven ability to manage complex data projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely delivery, quality control, and alignment with business objectives.
Strong knowledge of data management principles, including data governance, metadata management, and data integration across diverse sources (e.g., databases, APIs).
Deep understanding of data governance frameworks and best practices, ensuring data privacy, security, and compliance with relevant legislation and regulation such as the
Access to Information Act (ATIA), the Protection of Privacy Act (POPA) and the Access to Motor Vehicle Information Regulation (AMVIR).

Technology is the enabling force powering Vanguard’s client experience, investment products, and advice. As technology continues to evolve, so does the need for leaders who can identify, assess, and mitigate risk across complex systems. Vanguard’s Technology Leadership Program (TLP) is designed to develop the next generation of IT leaders through hands-on experience, collaboration, and rotational learning. Through three unique rotations, you will build technical expertise in cybersecurity and risk while developing the leadership skills needed to protect Vanguard and its clients.

Protect What Matters Most

At Vanguard, we’re committed to doing what’s right for our clients - and that starts with protecting their data, assets, and trust. As part of the Technology Leadership Program in the Risk & Security Analyst track, you’ll help identify, assess, and mitigate risks that impact Vanguard’s systems, operations, and clients. Your work will contribute to safeguarding Vanguard against evolving cybersecurity threats and operational risks. Through real-world assignments and collaboration across technology and business teams, you’ll gain exposure to how risk and security practices enable Vanguard to deliver secure, reliable services to investors.

Are you a self-starter who thrives on solving complex challenges and thinking critically about risk? Join a team where innovation is driven by purpose. You’ll work alongside cybersecurity, technology, and business partners to analyze threats, strengthen controls, and support risk-informed decision-making. Through technical capstones, hackathons, and hands-on projects, you’ll build both your analytical skillset and your ability to collaborate, influence, and lead. 

The Technology Leadership Program is a two-year rotational development experience designed for graduating students ready to begin their careers in technology. Participants complete three eight-month rotations across Risk & Security-focused teams, gaining exposure to different areas such as cybersecurity operations, threat intelligence, risk management, and identity & access management - while increasing ownership, responsibility, and leadership capability over time.

In this program, you will: 

Support efforts to identify, assess, and mitigate cybersecurity and operational risks
Analyze potential threats, vulnerabilities, and risk scenarios across systems and processes
Contribute to reporting, dashboards, or insights that support risk-informed decision-making

Take ownership of projects and contribute to delivering meaningful outcomes

Build a network with program managers, alumni, senior leaders, and peers
Meet regularly with your department manager and program manager to receive personalized coaching and mentorship

Strong interest in cybersecurity, threat analysis, risk management, or fraud prevention
Demonstrated leadership potential, initiative, and ability to take ownership of work
Strong analytical, communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative, team-oriented environment

new_jobs.title: Technology Leadership Program - Risk & Security Analyst (NC) NEW
new_jobs.description:
Technology is the enabling force powering Vanguard’s client experience, investment products, and advice. As technology continues to evolve, so does the need for leaders who can identify, assess, and mitigate risk across complex systems. Vanguard’s Technology Leadership Program (TLP) is designed to develop the next generation of IT leaders through hands-on experience, collaboration, and rotational learning. Through three unique rotations, you will build technical expertise in cybersecurity and risk while developing the leadership skills needed to protect Vanguard and its clients.

Protect What Matters Most

At Vanguard, we’re committed to doing what’s right for our clients - and that starts with protecting their data, assets, and trust. As part of the Technology Leadership Program in the Risk & Security Analyst track, you’ll help identify, assess, and mitigate risks that impact Vanguard’s systems, operations, and clients. Your work will contribute to safeguarding Vanguard against evolving cybersecurity threats and operational risks. Through real-world assignments and collaboration across technology and business teams, you’ll gain exposure to how risk and security practices enable Vanguard to deliver secure, reliable services to investors.

Are you a self-starter who thrives on solving complex challenges and thinking critically about risk? Join a team where innovation is driven by purpose. You’ll work alongside cybersecurity, technology, and business partners to analyze threats, strengthen controls, and support risk-informed decision-making. Through technical capstones, hackathons, and hands-on projects, you’ll build both your analytical skillset and your ability to collaborate, influence, and lead. 

The Technology Leadership Program is a two-year rotational development experience designed for graduating students ready to begin their careers in technology. Participants complete three eight-month rotations across Risk & Security-focused teams, gaining exposure to different areas such as cybersecurity operations, threat intelligence, risk management, and identity & access management - while increasing ownership, responsibility, and leadership capability over time.

In this program, you will: 

Support efforts to identify, assess, and mitigate cybersecurity and operational risks
Analyze potential threats, vulnerabilities, and risk scenarios across systems and processes
Contribute to reporting, dashboards, or insights that support risk-informed decision-making
Partner with security, technology, and business teams to strengthen controls and processes
Gain hands-on experience in risk management, cybersecurity frameworks, and digital ethics
Apply Agile methodologies to support risk and security initiatives in a dynamic environment
Take ownership of projects and contribute to delivering meaningful outcomes
Collaborate across teams, share insights, and drive solutions in a supportive environment
Build a network with program managers, alumni, senior leaders, and peers
Meet regularly with your department manager and program manager to receive personalized coaching and mentorship 

What it takes: 

Bachelor's or Master's degree with a concentration in computer science, computer engineering, IST, IT, CIS, Security, Risk, Cybersecurity or related technical/engineering subject matter required 
Strong interest in cybersecurity, threat analysis, risk management, or fraud prevention
Demonstrated leadership potential, initiative, and ability to take ownership of work
Strong analytical, communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative, team-oriented environment
Cumulative GPA of 3.2 or higher preferred

Special Factors 

Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position. 
This position will begin in 2027 and students graduating in December 20266 or Spring 2027 are encouraged to apply. 

Our Total Rewards package reflects our commitment to you and your family’s well-being – both for today and for the future. We invest in your financial, physical, and personal success with best-in-class benefits through:

Pay for performance, including annual performance bonuses, merit increases, and an annual Partnership bonus. 
Industry-leading retirement savings plans: 
401(k) contribution 55% above the national average. 
Quarterly 401(k) contribution of 10% of your eligible pay. 
At least 18 paid days off, plus 10 federal holidays. 
77% of your medical costs are covered, compared to 68% by other financial services companies. 
Unparalleled Health Savings Account (HSA) seed and match – 5x the amount as other contributing employers. 
A $1500 FlexFund annual stipend for personally meaningful conveniences – 3x the average amount offered by other employers. 
Top-tier programs for your emotional and mental health: 
Access to 2x more coaching and therapy sessions compared to other employers. 
A caregiving concierge program, something only one in five employers offer. 

Special Factors

Sponsorship

Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.

About Vanguard

At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission.

To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best.

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

Perpetual Wealth

The wealth management business consists of three distinct brands in addition to Perpetual Private - Fordham, Jacaranda Financial Planning and Priority Life - offering a unique mix of wealth management, advice and trustee services. With a diverse range of capabilities including strategic advice on superannuation and retirement planning, general investment, asset protection, insurance, tax management, estate planning, aged care, social security, succession planning and philanthropy. Research, assess and recommend investment managers and opportunities across Real Assets, Equities, Growth Alternatives and Responsible Investment strategies.

Monitor and maintain the Approved Product List (APL) and contribute to portfolio construction and manager selection decisions.

Support the design, review and ongoing management of implemented and model portfolios.

Prepare and present investment research and recommendations to Investment Committees and contribute to Board and committee papers.

Strong portfolio construction, analytical, modelling and quantitative skills, with knowledge of ESG and Responsible Investing principles.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work independently and take ownership of investment decisions.

Our unique culture is underpinned by our three organisational behaviours, Stretch, Own it, Make an impact which drive our approach of day-to-day interactions with colleagues and clients, the way we approach decision-making to the questions we ask and the problems we solve.

Work from anywhere in Australia for up to one month each year

to join our team in Calgary, Canada
. Reporting to the appropriate GBS leadership team, this role will lead and deliver cross-functional projects across Finance, HR, IT, Legal, Compliance, and other business functions, ensuring successful execution, governance, and adoption of scalable business solutions within a global environment.

The Location:
 This position is based in Calgary, Canada.

The Company:
Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality, and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous, ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Responsibilities

As  Project Manager - Global Business Services (GBS)
 you will be responsible for these activities:

Apply GBS PMO standards and governance practices across projects and initiatives.
Lead end-to-end project delivery, including planning, scope definition, execution, governance, and project closure.
Manage project timelines, budgets, dependencies, risks, resources, and deliverables to ensure successful outcomes.
Develop robust project plans capable of adapting to implementation challenges and evolving business requirements.
Drive process improvement, systems implementation, governance, compliance, and business transformation initiatives across GBS functions.
Partner with stakeholders across Finance, HR, IT, Legal, Compliance, Security, and external vendors to deliver scalable business solutions.
Develop business cases, cost-benefit analyses, ROI assessments, and project performance reporting.
Manage project risks, issues, change management activities, and stakeholder communications throughout the project lifecycle.
Support portfolio management, resource planning, and prioritization across multiple concurrent projects.
Integrate change management and communications planning throughout the full project lifecycle.
Provide executive-level project reporting, dashboards, presentations, and recommendations to leadership teams.
Mentor project managers and promote project management best practices across the organization.
Support data governance and reporting initiatives to improve visibility, efficiency, cost control, and decision-making.

Qualifications

Must Have:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.
PMP certification or equivalent project management qualification preferred.
5+ years of project management experience within a PMO, shared services, or enterprise environment.
Proven experience leading large, complex, cross-functional projects and programs.
Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, governance frameworks, and delivery practices.
Experience managing project budgets, business cases, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.
Ability to work effectively with senior leaders and influence stakeholders across all organizational levels.
Strong communication, presentation, leadership, negotiation, and change management skills.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced global environment.
Experience working within regulated, risk-sensitive environments while handling confidential information.

Nice To Have:

Experience delivering projects using Agile, Scrum, Design Thinking, MVP, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
Experience with legal operations, compliance programs, governance frameworks, legal technology platforms, or legal spend management.
Experience leading enterprise-wide system implementations, cloud migrations, or application consolidation initiatives.
Exposure to system integrations, process automation, and data governance projects.

Key Success Factors:

Ability to translate complex or ambiguous business challenges into structured, actionable project plans.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and build trusted partnerships.
Proactive, organized, and results-oriented approach to project delivery.
Strong commercial acumen with a focus on business value, efficiency, and measurable outcomes.
Ability to identify risks early and implement practical mitigation strategies.
Commitment to continuous improvement, governance excellence, and operational discipline.

Conduct deep-dive customer profiling and multi-dimensional segmentation to map cross-pillar journey touchpoints and tier progression.

The InProduction team has spent the better part of the last decade combining the best seating and staging companies into a one-stop shop for most of what is needed to produce an event. Starting with SGA Production Services, we added and integrated T&B Equipment, CommuniLux Productions, Nussli U.S., and Seating Solutions to become today’s InProduction. These acquisitions have allowed InProduction to evolve into the largest provider of temporary seating, staging, structures, and scenic production for the United States events industry. Central are our people.

As an InProduction employee you are central to our sustained growth and success. We offer a rewarding career in a fast paced and exciting environment. Our employees demonstrate our core values in safety and quality every day while working to provide top notch service to our client partners. Whether working in the field, yard, warehouse, or office, InProduction offers a future with huge growth potential.

Come join us! Check out our web page https://inproduction.net/welcome/

The Project Manager is responsible for managing project timelines and budgets while creating and implementing technical solutions and construction methods based on design concepts and visual information. The Project Manager must possess the ability to multi-task while maintaining attention to detail and must be highly organized. This position requires hands on experience related to Scheduling, Written and Verbal Communication, and/or general construction practices. The Project Manager must be willing to travel locally (40-50%) and out of market (15-20%) as required by project. This position reports to the Director of Operations & Vice President.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Onsite project management lead for all greater NY based jobs – approx 40-50% out of office in market
Complete daily progress reports with crew attendance, photos & completion metrics for each day a job is active in the field
Conduct site visits as needed for any greater NY area jobs
Travel out of market as needed when nationwide project management bandwidth is limited during busier times – approx 15-20% out of market travel
Per diem & travel expenses covered for all out of market travel to jobs/site visits
Accompany clients, building dept, fire marshals etc on walkthroughs to inspect & confirm all installations are built to code & clients agreed to desires; acquire sign off on all projects prior to completion & exiting the job site
Oversee project prep in Hauppauge WH prior to events – including but not limited to tools, hardware, materials & other misc equipment needs
Assist with local project planning, schedules & logistics
Ensure crews attend safety orientations, are up to date on all safety requirements & adhere to all safety regulations & have proper PPE while working
Manage all job specific purchasing & procurement
Assist WH manager with creation & verification of BOLs on inbound & outbound material
Assist in development of project cost estimates in collaboration with the sales team
Coordinate and review all technical drawings with the CAD Department & project foreman to ensure all details of job are captured prior to arriving onsite
Coordinate and review detailed assembly/installation drawings with project foreman for use by the installation crew to ensure all details of job are captured prior to arriving onsite for load in
Actively communicate with management & warehouse team to maintain shop production & logistics schedules in coordination with the project onsite
Work closely with department heads and subcontractors to meet both budgetary and scheduling goals
Communicate with the client, management & sales staff during the build & strike phases of the project to ensure all parties are aligned with progress, milestones & deadlines
Manage changes to the project scope onsite & report any budgetary and/or staffing implications back to management
Track and Report project costs compared to budget, assemble post mortem reports on all projects to give top-line view of how each project fared in comparison to estimates

Requirements

Previous industry experience in scaffolding, construction, technical theater and/or scenic fabrication is a plus but not required
Proficiency with MS Office & Teams
High-level problem-solving skills
Ability to make decisions when prioritizing the short- and long-term objectives for projects
Must have outstanding relationship skills and have a team oriented, collaborative work ethic
Ability to work within a flexible schedule
Valid Drivers License
Availability to report to Hauppauge office all work days not scheduled to be present on jobsites
Bilingual a major plus, but not required

Education Qualifications

High School Diploma or Equivalent

Position summary

This is a surge support position through January 15, 2026.
Extension is possible but not guaranteed. The position is hybrid, with the office in Washington, DC, supporting a federal client and requires an active public trust or better clearance. Remote candidates will be considered.

Sikich seeks an experienced Technical Business Analyst and Project Manager to support a federal client infrastructure operations team through dual capabilities: (1) assessing technical and operational workflows to identify automation and AI opportunities, and (2) managing multiple infrastructure and cloud migration initiatives from planning through delivery.

This hybrid role combines process improvement analysis with project delivery coordination. You will assess the team's technical and business processes, document workflows and dependencies, identify gaps and bottlenecks, recommend improvements, manage project schedules and risks, remove delivery roadblocks, and communicate status to leadership. You will work closely with engineering staff, project sponsors, and program leadership to improve service delivery, reduce manual effort, accelerate cloud migration timelines, and create measurable gains in productivity and operational outcomes.

This role requires United States citizenship and a Public Trust. Preference is given to candidates located in the National Capital Region, including Washington, DC, Maryland, and Virginia.

What will you do in this role?

You will combine business analysis and project management to drive infrastructure modernization and operational improvements:

Analysis & Process Improvement

Map and document existing technical and business processes, identifying inefficiencies and automation candidates
Partner with engineering staff to validate findings and help implement approved recommendations
Advise on adoption of Microsoft 365 tools, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot, and related AI capabilities
Develop measurements to report on productivity and outcome improvements resulting from changes
Produce detailed technical and business process workflow documentation

Project Delivery & Coordination

Manage multiple infrastructure projects from planning through delivery
Develop and maintain integrated schedules, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, action items, and decision logs
Manage Jira tickets and Confluence pages for assigned projects and ensure project documentation remains current
Facilitate meetings, document discussions and decisions, assign follow-up actions, and remove delivery roadblocks
Support adoption and refinement of agile and SAFe practices in an infrastructure operations environment
Aggregate technical inputs and publish concise status reports for client and company leadership
Create, edit, review, and coordinate formal project deliverables and presentation materials

What do you need to succeed in this role?

Empathy, patience and professionalism when working directly with end users, including the ability to explain technical steps clearly over remote sessions.
Sound judgment to ask for help, appropriate escalation of issues, and the ability to provide enough technical detail for senior administrators to act quickly.
Basic Excel proficiency for tracking device lists, remediation status, deployment results, and issue trends.
Ticketing system literacy, with ServiceNow and/or JIRA experience helpful but trainable on the job.

Desired Qualifications:

Required background includes hands-on experience in both of the following areas:

Business Analysis & Process Improvement:

8+ years’ experience in project management
7+ years' experience in process analysis, documentation, and process improvement
4+ years' hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and AI capabilities (Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot)
Demonstrated experience documenting current-state and future-state workflows, facilitating working sessions with technical and business stakeholders, developing process maps and standard operating procedures, and translating findings into actionable recommendations
Experience in federal government, regulated, or enterprise IT environments

Project Management & Delivery:

8+ years' total information technology experience
7+ years' experience managing complex IT projects
5+ years' experience in a client-facing role
2+ years' experience supporting federal government or government-contracting environments
Demonstrated infrastructure and/or cloud project management experience
Hands-on, current experience with Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Visio, and Microsoft Office

In compliance with this state’s pay transparency laws, the salary range for this role is $135,000-$145,000. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location.

In addition, successful candidates will bring a service-oriented mindset, clear communication, sound troubleshooting judgment, and the ability to work collaboratively with technical teams and end users in a remote federal client environment.

Servant Leader – You are hyper focused on engaging employees, fostering their development, and building a positive culture.

Sikich, offers the public and private sectors a diverse platform of professional services across consulting, technology, and compliance. Are you a seasoned Biology Project Manager looking to help shape the future of habitat restoration and environmental consulting in Southern California? Join HELIX Environmental Planning, an employee-owned firm where your expertise as a Biology Project Manager will directly influence meaningful restoration, conservation, and infrastructure projects across the region. You'll have the opportunity to grow with a thriving Pasadena team while working on projects that span coastal, mountain, and desert ecosystems.

Why HELIX?

HELIX is a full-service environmental consulting and planning firm specializing in biological resources, habitat restoration, regulatory permitting, and environmental compliance. What sets HELIX apart is our ability to design, implement, and monitor restoration projects entirely in-house, from growing native plants to long-term success monitoring. As a Biology Project Manager, you'll join a collaborative, employee-owned organization that values innovation, technical excellence, and professional growth. This position follows a hybrid schedule with three days per week in the office.

Day in the Life

As a Biology Project Manager, you'll lead diverse biological resources projects throughout Southern California. One day you may be guiding habitat restoration planning and coordinating with regulatory agencies; the next you'll be partnering with clients, preparing technical reports, managing project teams, and supporting business development efforts. The Biology Project Manager role offers the perfect blend of project leadership, client engagement, strategic planning, and occasional field involvement. You'll play a key role in expanding HELIX's restoration and biology presence throughout the Los Angeles region.

What You'll Do

Serve as a Biology Project Manager for biological resources and habitat restoration projects.
Lead regulatory permitting efforts and agency consultation.
Prepare and oversee biological technical reports and restoration plans.
Manage environmental review support and biological resources analysis.
Build and maintain strong client and agency relationships.
Coordinate project teams, schedules, budgets, and deliverables.
Prepare proposals and support business development activities.
Develop creative solutions to complex project challenges.
Collaborate across disciplines to achieve successful project outcomes.
Occasionally conduct biological fieldwork as needed.

new_jobs.title: AI & Data Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About IntouchCX

IntouchCX is a global leader in digital customer experience management, back office processing, trust & safety solutions, and AI services. For over 25 years, we’ve scaled with soul, building trusted long-term partnerships and empowering our people to drive positive change.

About The Job

We are changing the way people think about customer care, and we need your help!

We’re looking for an AI & Data Business Analyst to bridge the gap between business strategy, data analytics, and artificial intelligence. You will assist with performing User Acceptance Testing (UAT), the operationalization of business, process, and system changes, and driving data-driven decisions through dashboard creation and AI-powered insights across training curriculums, quality assurance, and reporting.

As AI & Data Business Analyst, You Will…

Collect and validate data requirements for business intelligence and AI systems.
Build, design, and maintain dynamic, executive-facing dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to support reporting and visualize data from multiple applications.
Identify AI opportunities and define business requirements to integrate Generative AI and machine learning solutions into existing operational workflows.
Create, validate, and recommend optimization of business processes using data-driven insights and AI capabilities.
Support projects through development, quality assurance, user acceptance testing (UAT), and production implementation for both traditional software and data/AI models.
Leverage AI tools and methodologies to discover patterns, clean large datasets, interpret anomalies, and automate repetitive data preparation tasks.
Create internal guides, training materials, and end-user documentation for new BI dashboards and AI features.
Facilitate requirements workshops to connect business leaders with AI, data, and technical development teams.
Build and manage business relationships, ensuring AI and data solutions solve real business problems, reduce operational costs, and generate measurable ROI.

As an AI & Data Business Analyst, You Need…

A Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or equivalent experience.
3-5 years of practical business/data analysis experience, with demonstrated experience in analyzing systems, creating structured business requirements documents (BRDs), and working with complex data.
AI fluency: a strong understanding of how generative AI and large language models (LLMs) work, and the ability to apply AI tools to accelerate analysis, forecasting, and reporting.
Dashboarding and visualization experience. Hands-on experience building user-friendly reports and visualizations using BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, joining, and business analysis. Familiarity with Python (Pandas, NumPy) or R for scalable analytics workflows is a strong asset.
Demonstrated experience creating and leading testing (UAT), including evaluating the accuracy and performance of AI solutions.
Business process management practitioner designation, CBAP, Lean Six Sigma (yellow or black), PMP, or AI/Data analytics certifications are considered an asset.
Experience facilitating workshops and training sessions with diverse groups of stakeholders to drive AI adoption and tech literacy.
Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational and time management skills.
Demonstrated strength in communications (both verbal and written), with the ability to translate complex numerical data and AI concepts into a clear narrative that drives action.
Strong problem-solving skills and comfort with ambiguity when defining the scope of new data or AI projects.

new_jobs.description:
CBRE is seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Senior Project Manager to lead the delivery of complex construction and renovation projects from initiation through closeout. This role requires strong technical expertise, exceptional client service skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with minimal oversight.

The Senior Project Manager is a hands-on delivery leader responsible for developing budgets and schedules, managing contractors and vendors, and ensuring projects meet client expectations for quality, cost, and timing. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with extensive project management experience across multiple sectors who thrives in fast-paced environments and can maintain excellent client relationships while delivering results.

Key Responsibilities

Identify, pursue, and secure new project opportunities, leveraging market knowledge to drive business growth.
Independently develop complete project estimates, proposals, and schedules, and present them effectively to clients.
Execute subcontractor procurement, including competitive bidding, negotiations, and contract execution.
Oversee all aspects of subcontractor and vendor performance, ensuring adherence to project requirements, budgets, and schedules.
Manage full project financials, including billing, budget tracking, change orders, and cost reconciliation.
Create and maintain project schedules, ensuring timely completion of all milestones.
Spend substantial time onsite to monitor quality, safety, and progress.
Maintain proactive communication with clients, setting expectations and resolving issues.
Represent CBRE with professionalism, integrity, and exceptional client service.

Qualifications

8–10 years of proven project management experience in construction, preferably across multiple sectors such as commercial, healthcare, life sciences, education, and industrial.
Track record of delivering projects ranging from $500,000 to $10 million in value.
Strong capabilities in estimating, subcontractor negotiation, contract administration, financial management, and scheduling.
Ability to independently manage multiple concurrent projects without dedicated administrative support.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Project).
Degree in engineering, architecture, or construction management preferred; relevant experience required.
Exceptional interpersonal and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly communicate complex information.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

Why CBRE

We lead by example, guided by the needs of the cities we inhabit, the communities we build, and the world we live in. The more perspectives we have, the more dimensions we’re able to see. A culture of respect, integrity, service, and excellence shapes our approach to every opportunity.

new_jobs.title: Staff Program Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Staff Program Intelligence Analyst

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard – from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.

Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.

The Role

We’re seeking a strategic, hands-on Staff-level individual contributor to set direction and deliver the future of Program Intelligence, analytics, and AI across the Program Management organization. This role operates at the intersection of enterprise data strategy, storytelling, and portfolio execution — enabling senior leadership to make faster, smarter decisions through trusted, high-quality, actionable insights. The successful candidate will work with broad autonomy, navigate significant ambiguity, and influence outcomes across organizational boundaries without direct authority.

You will define and advance the Program Intelligence strategy, establishing scalable patterns, standards, and governance for data products (dashboards, AI Agents, web applications, and analytics pipelines). You’ll work directly with PMO leaders and cross-functional partners to deliver high-impact, customer-facing capabilities and narratives that connect data to business outcomes. You will also raise the capability of the broader organization through mentoring, coaching, and reusable practices while remaining an individual contributor.

Why This Role Matters

GM’s vehicle portfolio is evolving faster than ever and demands sharper insight and tighter alignment across the enterprise. This role defines how Program Management measures what matters — turning data into the connective tissue between strategy, capacity, and execution. The impact of this role extends beyond individual deliverables: it establishes the intelligence capabilities, decision frameworks, and operating standards that enable leaders and teams to execute with greater clarity and speed.

What You’ll Do

Set the Program Intelligence & Reporting Strategy: Define and evolve the long-term vision, principles, operating model, and architecture for management information, reporting, analytics, and dashboards that support portfolio, capacity, and delivery decision-making.
Lead portfolio-scale data products: Direct the design and delivery of trusted, decision-grade dashboards, AI Agents, web applications, and reports that establish a durable source of truth for program health, capacity, and delivery performance.
Establish metrics and data governance: Create common definitions, measurement frameworks, data quality expectations, and governance practices that improve consistency, comparability, and confidence in enterprise decisions.
Architect analytics and AI solutions: Translate ambiguous, high-impact business needs into scalable data models, analytical products, AI-driven solutions, and reusable technical patterns in partnership with data engineering, IT, and product teams.
Influence executive decisions: Synthesize complex data and competing perspectives into clear narratives, recommendations, and decision frameworks that drive alignment and action at the senior leadership level.
Drive adoption and measurable value: Champion the use of Program Intelligence capabilities, assess adoption and business impact, and continuously improve products and practices based on customer feedback and evolving portfolio needs.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of progressive experience in business intelligence, analytics, data products, management reporting, or a related discipline, including experience leading complex, enterprise-level initiatives.
Advanced experience with SQL, Python, cloud analytics platforms (e.g., Databricks, AWS), and the development or application of AI-driven solutions in an enterprise environment.
Demonstrated success defining strategy and delivering scalable dashboards, reporting products, data pipelines, analytics platforms, or AI-enabled experiences using modern tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Databricks, or equivalent technologies.
Proven ability to connect metrics to business strategy and portfolio outcomes, translating operational data into executive-level insights, recommendations, and decision frameworks.
Exceptional communication, visualization, facilitation, and data storytelling skills, with the ability to influence senior audiences and align stakeholders around complex decisions.
Recognized as a trusted advisor and thought leader who collaborates and influences across technical, product, and business stakeholders, aligns diverse perspectives around shared metrics and insights, and delivers results without direct authority.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

MBA or advanced degree in business, data science, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative discipline.
Background in large-scale technology, product, engineering, or enterprise transformation environments, with experience scaling data-driven decision frameworks and operating models.
Deep knowledge of data science, machine learning, generative AI, responsible AI, and the practical application of these capabilities to enterprise decision-making.
Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous, enterprise-wide business needs into structured intelligence strategies, governed metrics, scalable reporting systems, and insight-driven products with measurable adoption and impact.

Hybrid or Remote:
This role is categorized as hybrid for those within commutable distance. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to our Engineering Technical Center in Warren (MI) or Austin (TX) three times per week at minimum otherwise open to virtual.

Compensation:
The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The compensation may not be representative for positions located outside of the California Bay Area.

The salary range for this role is $134,700 to $245,00. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.

Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance.

Benefits:
GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more.

Company Vehicle:
Upon successful completion of a motor vehicle report review, you will be eligible to participate in a company vehicle evaluation program, through which you will be assigned a General Motors vehicle to drive and evaluate. Note: program participants are required to purchase/lease a qualifying GM vehicle every four years unless one of a limited number of exceptions applies.

GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc).

About GM

Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.

Why Join Us

We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.

Benefits Overview

From day one, we're looking out for your well-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting Total Rewards resources
